name: lazarus-x
description: LAZARUS-X: Forensic Relational Database Reconstruction & Cryptographic Provenance Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci
scripts.start: npm run build:frontend && cd backend && npx prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npx ts-node --files src/index.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:intake
scripts.validate:db: cd backend && npx prisma validate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test:security: npm run validate:db && npm run typecheck:backend
scripts.test:all: npm test && python scripts/test_analyze_sqlite.py && npm run test:e2e
